data.name: Combat Trick / Whirlwind Attack
data.description: When using this feat, you can spend stamina points to still take bonus or extra attacks granted by other feats, spells, or abilities. You must spend 5 stamina points per extra attack you take in this way. This combat trick allows you to make extra attacks to which you have access-it doesn't by itself grant extra attacks.
